title: The frame catalog (version 1)
summary: The versioned frame catalog the experiment route trains on: 2-D grey frames, 27 levels, split by person.
does: A read-only, versioned SQLite store of every banked frame with its level boxes, built from content-hashed shards and data/registry/ by the catalog step (CatalogFlow); unchanged bytes make no new version. Every frame keeps its person key, and the split puts each person on one side only: the frozen test persons, a salted hash share of 0.1 for validation, the rest training. The images stay on the grid; the experiment route trains on the version grid/v1-version.sh chooses. The levels are C1 to C7, T1 to T13, L1 to L6 and the sacrum, 27 in all (src/schwingnet/catalog.py LEVELS).

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: Grey frames with level boxes, N x 1 x H x W, split into train, validation and test by person.

today.note: the experiment route reads the catalog version grid/v1-version.sh chooses

card.origin: The bank and catalog steps: tools/ingest.py turns each bank into a content-hashed shard and CatalogFlow builds the versioned store from the shards and data/registry/.
card.where: On the grid only, as versions/catalog-NNNNNN-<hash>.sqlite under the data root; images never enter the repository.
card.count: Not recorded in the repository: the grid's current version holds it. The dry run of docs/research/v1-demo/README.md had 1,633 synthetic frames.
card.persons: Every frame carries its person key, and every count and split is by person (src/schwingnet/catalog.py).
card.split: test: the frozen persons of data/splits/test-persons.json; validation: a person whose salted hash falls in the share 0.1 of data/splits/rule.json; training: the rest; the split check holds every version to this rule.
card.held_out: C-ArmLSpine case42, case121 and case136 (the L6 stratum) and case134 and case39 (the demo sweeps, never trained on) are test persons.
card.licence: Uncut: the catalog holds sources of every licence class of data/licences.json; a recipe of data/recipes/ cuts it before training.
